stimulus: Twenty deterministic, single-block known-answer comparisons using the pinned upstream bench.
scope: AES core key expansion, block encryption and block decryption for 128-bit and 256-bit keys.

test_metadata.checker: The upstream bench compares the 128-bit result against each expected block and reports a numbered verdict and aggregate count.

specification.requirement: Cipher and inverse cipher transform 128-bit blocks using the expanded key for the selected key length.

coverage.reason: The pinned checker reports known-answer comparisons. Per-test execution coverage has not been measured.

dossier_notes: The proposed checker control requires scoped runner support and exact approval. The bus wrapper and AES-192 are outside this configuration. The two S-box files are build dependencies.
